name: Hecla Mining Company
moat_justification: No pricing power — a pure silver price-taker. The mining version of a moat (cost-curve position, reserve life, jurisdiction) is genuinely above average: Greens Creek's by-product credits make its silver cash cost negative, Lucky Friday is long-life and at record output, and Hecla is North America's largest primary silver producer in U.S./Canadian jurisdictions only. But the measured history caps it: ROIC (fundamentals.json roic_proxy) was 3.2% / -0.4% / -1.4% / 2.2% / 13.2% over 2021-25 — near zero through the cycle, spiking only with the silver price — and gross margin swung 16-44% on price alone. An asset-quality edge, not a franchise.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 5.6%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Largest North American primary silver producer, moat 4/10 — TTM OE is real but struck at peak silver prices and the through-cycle median OE is negative; at $15.30 the weighted IRR is only 6.6% (IV@15 $5.11), and it clears 15% only below ~$5.11.
moat_for: Greens Creek: one of the world's largest, lowest-cost silver mines — gold/zinc/lead by-product credits cover production costs (negative consolidated silver cash costs in Q2 2026)
Lucky Friday: long reserve life (17 years per company reporting), high-grade, record 1.5 Moz in Q2 2026
Largest primary silver producer in the U.S. and Canada; all assets in tier-1 U.S./Canadian jurisdictions with decades-old permits and infrastructure
Effectively debt-free balance sheet after the Casa Berardi sale and senior-note redemption funds exploration and the Keno Hill ramp internally
moat_against: Pure commodity price-taker: earnings are the silver spot price, which struck the current base at $63-83/oz realized vs ~$35 a year earlier
Through-cycle ROIC near zero (2021-25 roic_proxy: 3.2% / -0.4% / -1.4% / 2.2% / 13.2%) — no demonstrated above-cost-of-capital returns at mid-cycle prices
Reserves deplete yearly and must be replaced with capex or M&A; share count has grown 5.6%/yr on issuance
Three-mine concentration after the Casa Berardi sale, Greens Creek roughly half of silver output; Keno Hill still ramping with power/permitting issues
